title: engineering-units: engineering unit conversion from exact definitions in JavaScript
description:
Zero-dependency JavaScript library for engineering unit conversion: pressure (including psi, ksi, kgf/cm² and inches of water), energy, power (including horsepower, BTU/h and refrigeration tons), force, torque, flow rate (gpm, cfm, L/min), speed, density and angular speed. Every factor is derived from an exact definition, and the test suite checks units against published values and round-trips every pair. It also converts text such as "30 psi to bar".

Also on npm as engineering-units. Author: David Mashiah.
